NEW YORK -- The Brooklyn Nets (3-9) definitely did not have the kind of road trip they were hoping for after dropping three of four games in frustrating fashion for such a young team. Brooklyn has been discussing how the team needs to remain connected in times of adversity, especially on the road, but it seems like head coach Jordi Fernandez is trying to keep things simple as well.
 "I think consistency and playing hard and with purpose, and I think that when we've done it, we've had good results. We've been able to compete and keep growing," Fernandez said prior to Monday's matchup against the Philadelphia 76ers . Through the Nets were able to blow out the New Orleans Pelicans , they also suffered disappointing losses to the Atlanta Hawks, Dallas Mavericks , and Memphis Grizzlies due to plenty of miscues and miscommunication.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "I think we've had good moments. Obviously, we had one win. We all would have loved to have more, but we got better," Fernandez continued. "We worked on the road, built chemistry, and we had to deal with some guys in, some guys out. But, that's part of the NBA, right? We're not here to make excuses, and everybody's got limitations on minutes because you're trying to protect your guys."
 Over the course of its four-game road trip, Brooklyn could have been at least 2-2 after leading the Hawks by as many as 17 points, but some of the same issues came back to bite them in the end. The double-digit losses to the Mavericks and Grizzlies were harder to swallow given that the Nets were saying all of the right things despite the unfortunate defeats.
 The good news for the Nets is that Monday will present the opportunity for them to correct the issues in front of their home crowd against one of the best teams in the Eastern Conference in the 76ers. Philadelphia will not have forward LeBron James and potentially won't have center Joel Embiid, but Brooklyn still has to worry about Tyrese Maxey, Jaylen Brown, and VJ Edgecombe. Nonetheless, the Nets have some work to do.
